text: 记者走访深圳华强北市场发现，消费级显卡价格出现明显上涨。以RTX 5060 Ti 8GB为例，目前市场售价已升至3400元，相比此前2350元的价格上涨逾千元，更高版本的RTX 5070 Ti 系列目前已经涨到8000元以上；高端产品涨幅更为明显，RTX 5090系列价格已从此前约2万元上涨至3.5万元左右。 “写不了报价单，一天一个价。”华强北多位商户告诉记者，硬件优先供应AI算力，推高了显卡成本，现在各大品牌工厂都在封仓，暂停对外批量出货，这样的突然涨价一时之间反应不过来。（21财经）
text_en: A reporter visiting Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei market found that consumer-grade graphics card prices have risen significantly. Taking the RTX 5060 Ti 8GB as an example, its market price has climbed to 3,400 yuan, up more than 1,000 yuan from the previous 2,350 yuan. Higher-tier models like the RTX 5070 Ti series have risen to over 8,000 yuan. Premium products saw even sharper gains, with the RTX 5090 series jumping from around 20,000 yuan to roughly 35,000 yuan. 'We can't even issue price quotes--prices change daily,' multiple Huaqiangbei merchants told the reporter. Hardware is being prioritized for AI computing power, driving up graphics card costs. Major brand factories are now sealing warehouses and halting bulk shipments, leaving merchants unable to react to such sudden price hikes. (21st Century Business Herald)
